headline: COSEDA tutorial presents SystemC-AMS virtual prototypes as verification reference models
fact: The DVCon Japan program lists a tutorial by COSEDA presenters Thilo Vörtler and Karsten Einwich on SystemC and SystemC-AMS virtual prototypes. Its published scope covers executable specifications for heterogeneous systems, analog/digital/software test development and reference models for implementation verification. The tutorial also previews future SystemC-AMS standardization; a preview is not a formally issued standard.
